grayscale.title: Grayscale shortcut
grayscale.intro: A grey screen is a boring screen. Set up a quick way to switch it on.
grayscale.step1: Open Settings › Accessibility › Colour and motion (the name varies by phone).
grayscale.step2: Turn on Colour correction, then choose Greyscale.
grayscale.step3: Add the shortcut to Quick Settings, or set the accessibility shortcut.
grayscale.step4: Switch it on in the evening, or whenever an app pulls you back in.

audit.title: 5-min notification audit
audit.intro: Most buzzes aren't for you. Five minutes now saves hours later.
audit.step3: Turn off everything that isn't a person or something time-critical.
audit.step4: For what's left, turn off sounds and badges where you can.

zones.title: Phone-free zones
zones.intro: Places where the phone doesn't go make the habit automatic.
zones.step1: Pick one place: the bedroom, the dinner table, or the bathroom.
zones.step2: Give the phone a home outside it: a charger in the hall works well.
zones.step3: Get a cheap alarm clock so the phone isn't your alarm.
zones.step4: Add a second zone once the first one feels normal.
